items.title: Zach Charbonnet: Ruled out for Week 7
items.text:
Head coach Mike Macdonald said Friday that Charbonnet (knee) has been ruled out for Sunday's game versus the Chiefs, Curtis Crabtree of Fox 13 Seattle reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Dalton Schultz: Cleared for Week 7
items.text:
Schultz (quadriceps) was a full participant in Friday's practice and doesn't have an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Giants, Adam Caplan or SiriusXM reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Jaylen Waddle: Expects to play Sunday
items.text:
Waddle (chest) said he is good to go for Sunday's game at Arizona after being listed as a limited practice participant the previous two days, Chris Tomasson of The Denver Gazette reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Mike Evans: Ruled out for Week 7
items.text:
Evans (Achilles) is out for Sunday's game against the Falcons, Matt Barrows of The Athletic reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: George Pickens: Full practice Friday
items.text:
Pickens (shoulder) was a full participant in Friday's practice, Tommy Yarrish of the Cowboys' official site reports.
